summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend fully validated. 26/26 pytest cases pass for categories, comments, ambiences, subscribers, settings, chapters persistence, cascade delete, audio upload/stream/12MB limit. Frontend: virtual 'Toutes mes créations' tab, category tabs from backend, filters (search + sort A→Z reorders posters), category badges on Home and Detail, ChapterReader (TOC toggle, next/prev navigation, close), CommentsSection (create + appears in list), Contact page (name/bio/socials, newsletter subscribe success), Contact edit + save persistence, Settings PIN unlock (1234), CategoryManager (add category appears as new Home tab), SubscribersManager, AmbienceManager (add + shown in list), SoundPack selection, mute toggle. Only observation: Born X Burn seeded creation exists in DB with launch_type='reader' (0 chapters) instead of launch_type='chapters' with 1 chapter — this is stale seed from iteration 1 (ensure_seed skips reseeding when count > 0). Not a code bug; the code specifies chapters correctly. ChapterReader validated to work end-to-end with a freshly created chapters-type creation.

integration_issues.issue: Opens legacy reader modal instead of ChapterReader because seeded creation still has launch_type='reader' from iteration-1 seed data (ensure_seed does not update existing rows). All new/updated chapters creations work correctly.

action_items: Main agent: force-reseed or migrate Born X Burn to launch_type='chapters' with its seeded Chapter (e.g. call POST /api/seed?force=true once, or write an idempotent migration in ensure_seed that upgrades existing docs when launch_type differs). Warning: force reseed wipes user creations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ensure_seed() is only idempotent by 'is collection empty?' — it never upgrades existing docs. When schema/seed data evolves (as with chapters in iter-2), existing DBs remain stale. Consider a per-creation upsert-by-title migration, or version the seed and re-run on version bump.
server.py DEFAULT_CREATIONS: Born X Burn is defined with launch_type='chapters' and a chapter, but production DB shows launch_type='reader' — confirms the staleness above.
Backend still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (flagged in iter-1, still present). Migrate to lifespan handlers.
No auth on write endpoints (documented single-user + client-side PIN limitation; safe if deployment is truly single-tenant).
MAX_AUDIO_BYTES enforced only after reading full body into memory — for a 12 MB cap it's fine, but a streaming length check would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-2 flows (chapter reader validated with fresh chapters creation)

seed_data_creation: Playwright test created and deleted: 1 category (UITestCat), 1 ambience (UIAmb), 1 newsletter subscriber (pwtest_*), 1 chapters creation (TEST_ChapReader), several comments. All cleaned up. Pytest test data all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both backend_test.py (iter-1) and test_iteration2.py (iter-2) can be re-used as regression suite. When testing Born X Burn's chapter reader specifically, either force-reseed first or create a temp chapters creation via API. Home.js sort-select option values are order/az/za/recent (NOT 'alpha').
